sampling_frame: all 72 active datasets in the retained OpenML-CC18 suite manifest
claim_boundary: conditional benchmark release capability and held-out training-randomness validation; not representative government release yield, deployment safety, or population prevalence
eligibility_rule: include every active dataset in the sealed OpenML-CC18 suite manifest with a present snapshot whose SHA-256 matches the manifest; retain and report every failed training cell
extension_disclosure: the protocol, mechanisms, seeds, utility rule, profiles, and estimands are unchanged from design version 1, but expansion to all 72 datasets was decided after the original eight-dataset results were observed

profiles.protected_unit: one person represented by at most one training row
one person represented by at most one training row
one household represented by at most four training rows
one organization represented by at most ten training rows

selection_rule: maximize the predeclared weighted sum of development mean balanced accuracy over the complete three-release allocation, then maximize release count, then minimize composed epsilon and delta
utility_multiplicity_rule: Bonferroni one-sided exact binomial lower bounds across the three candidate mechanisms within each dataset
privacy_rule: independently replay each record-level accountant, lift it to the declared protected unit with basic group privacy, then apply sequential composition across the complete portfolio
evidence_asymmetry_rule: a validated DP accountant is a mechanism-relative ceiling; empirical membership attacks are lower bounds and can block but a null attack cannot clear
evaluation_rule: freeze selection on the twenty development seeds; evaluate reliability, proxy false clearance, release yield, portfolio success, and utility regret only on the ten untouched evaluation seeds
